# ECN-2026-046 - Change notice - Machining induction billet heater #1

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-IH01

Reason for change
-----------------
Background: Operational trials and incoming quality trends identified variance in billet surface condition and machining tool wear correlated to billet soak level prior to machining. A review of in-process data and feedback from maintenance and production teams indicated that the control setpoint for Machining induction billet heater #1 did not align with metallurgical targets derived during process validation. The intent of this ECN is to align the heater control with the validated billet target to stabilize machining outcomes and reduce rework.

Rationale: Setpoint alignment is necessary to reduce variability in billet microstructure at the machining interface and to extend cutter life by producing a consistent billet temperature at machine transfer. The target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C. Changing the heater control and associated operator steps to meet this target will reduce downstream variability and support consistent part quality.

Affected items
--------------
Scope: This change affects the following items in Plant P1, line P1-L3:
- Control logic and setpoint for EQ-P1-L3-IH01.
- Associated operator procedures and checklists referenced in SOP-P1-L3-04 and SOP-P1-L3-05.
- Machine transfer and handoff criteria between heating and machining cells on line P1-L3.
- Shift log entries and batch records where billet temperature at handoff is recorded.

Components and roles impacted: Production operators working on line P1-L3, maintenance technicians responsible for EQ-P1-L3-IH01, quality engineers reviewing machining output, and process engineers overseeing thermal treatments.

Exclusions: Equipment and processes not explicitly listed for line P1-L3 are not altered by this ECN.

Implementation
--------------
Change description: Adjust the control system for EQ-P1-L3-IH01 to hold billets at the target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C at the machine transfer point. Update operator procedures in SOP-P1-L3-04 and SOP-P1-L3-05 to reflect revised acceptance criteria, measurement method, and required records.

Steps for implementation:
- Update control logic configuration for EQ-P1-L3-IH01 to reference the target billet temperature of 1235 °C as the transfer setpoint. Confirm configuration change is logged in the control system change history.
- Revise SOP-P1-L3-04 and SOP-P1-L3-05 to:
  - Specify measurement method and instrument locations for verifying billet temperature prior to transfer.
  - Define acceptance wording that aligns with the new target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C.
  - Outline operator actions if the measured temperature deviates from the target.
- Conduct a controlled startup validation run where billets heated under the new setpoint are processed through machining and inspected. Document deviations and corrective actions in the validation record.
- Train affected personnel on revised procedures and make updated SOPs available in the document control system.

Examples of acceptable and unacceptable conditions:
- Example acceptable condition: Billet verification reading indicates alignment with the target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C immediately prior to transfer; machining proceeds with standard feed and speed parameters described in SOPs.
- Example unacceptable condition: Measurement shows deviation from the target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C; operator must hold the billet in heating station and notify maintenance and quality for disposition per SOP-P1-L3-04.

Verification and validation:
- Process engineer will review machining tool wear samples and first article parts produced under the new setpoint and record findings in the implementation report.
- Quality will perform dimensional and surface inspections per normal sampling criteria and log results. Any nonconforming trends will trigger a documented investigation.

Records to keep
---------------
Required records to be filed in the document control system and quality archive:
- Control system change record for EQ-P1-L3-IH01 capturing the configuration update and reason for change. Reference this ECN number when filing.
- Revised versions of SOP-P1-L3-04 and SOP-P1-L3-05 with change history and approval signatures.
- Training records for all operators and maintenance personnel who receive instruction on the revised procedures.
- Validation run report including batch identifiers, measurements, inspection results, and disposition of any out-of-spec billets.
- Shift logs and batch records indicating billet verification readings at transfer and any interventions.
- Corrective action documentation if unexpected deviations occur during rollout.

Approvals
---------
Approval by process engineering, maintenance management, and quality assurance is required prior to production use. The ECN references related documents for context and procedure control: ECN-2026-029, SOP-P1-L3-04, SOP-P1-L3-05. Signatures below indicate acceptance of scope, implementation approach, and record requirements as described in this document.

Approver fields:
- Process engineering approval
- Maintenance approval
- Quality assurance approval
- Production management approval

Notes
-----
- This change is focused on aligning thermal control for EQ-P1-L3-IH01 to the validated target billet temperature stated above to improve machining stability and part quality.
- All implementation activities must be documented and retained in accordance with plant record retention rules.
